name: Crest of Lordaeron
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database. Its experience counts the level 30 build, which halved what dungeon quests give beyond a normal quest.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: <A weathered crest depicting the mark of Lordaeron. With so few relics left after the kingdom's fall, someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this.>
narrative.objectives: Return the Crest of Lordaeron to Lady Dena Kennedy in Stormwind City.
narrative.offerRewardText: How in the world did you find this? It's in such remarkable condition... all things considered.Thank you for restoring this piece of Alliance history, champion. I'll have my best people get to work restoring this immediately.
narrative.requestItemsText: Welcome to the gallery. Feel free to browse.
